run_MoGe_call: run the MoGe model on an image tensor to get depth pointmaps and projection output
create_MoGe_instance: create a MoGe depth model instance wrapping a pretrained MoGe model on a given device
review_MoGe_call: review the MoGe __call__ method that infers 3D pointmaps from an input image tensor
summarize_MoGe_class: summarize the MoGe class which extends DepthModel to produce 3D pointmap predictions
test_MoGe_inference: test the MoGe model inference pipeline by passing a tensor and checking pointmap output
